quote: Milne asked if I had a theory. I told him not yet — that is the moment when an open case becomes one worth solving.

I did not want neat. I wanted trouble. The misfits are the thing that opens a locked house: an oil smear where a hand should carry prints, a pulley anchored where no respectable customer would fit it, a handkerchief with a monogram that did not belong to the dead woman.
The experiment had given me a plausible mechanism and a clock within which it could have been executed;
The loop's exact attachment — whether it had been tied to a screw, hooked, or simply tucked in — was not written in the file.
